summary: launch the plainkeep terminal UI (plainkeep-ui) — the plainkeep.json/3 contract-driven frontend
usage: plainkeep ui [args passed through to plainkeep-ui]
hints: Entry shim for the terminal UI: execs the installed `plainkeep-ui` binary (found on PATH, or via PLAINKEEP_UI_BIN), handing it the terminal — the TUI itself composes verbs over `plainkeep <verb> --json` + `plainkeep complete`. When plainkeep-ui isn't installed it prints a blocked-style install hint and exits cleanly (never a crash). Common mistake: expecting `plainkeep ui --json` to stream data — it launches an interactive UI (tty:true); drive plainkeep programmatically with `plainkeep <verb> --json` instead.
